name: x402 Testnet Integration with Radius Facilitator
query: Set up x402 payment gating on Radius testnet for my API. I have a fresh wallet that's never made an x402 payment before. Use the Radius testnet facilitator.
context: User is building on Radius testnet (chain ID 72344). Their wallet has testnet SBC but has never interacted with Permit2. They want to gate an endpoint at 0.001 SBC per request and also write a client script to test it.
expected_behavior: Server config uses network 'eip155:72344' (testnet, not mainnet)
Server returns 402 payment requirements in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header with accepts array
Client retries paid requests with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header
Client uses chain ID 72344 for EIP-2612 and Permit2 domain signatures
Amount '1000' for 0.001 SBC (6 decimal places, not 18)
Uses EIP-2612 gas sponsoring for first-time wallets when supported by the Radius testnet facilitator
Mentions Permit2 pre-approval only as a third-party facilitator fallback, not as the default Radius testnet path
success_criteria: Does NOT use the mainnet facilitator URL for testnet
Does NOT use third-party facilitator URLs as the default Radius testnet path
Does NOT use legacy X-Payment as the default x402 v2 payment header
Does NOT rely on response-body paymentRequirements[] as the canonical 402 discovery path
SBC token address is 0x33ad9e4BD16B69B5BFdED37D8B5D9fF9aba014Fb (same on testnet)
Permit2 contract address is 0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3 (same on testnet)
x402 Proxy address is 0x402085c248EeA27D92E8b30b2C58ed07f9E20001 (same on testnet)
EIP-2612 permit domain uses name 'Stable Coin' and version '1' (not 'SBC')
Fresh wallet pre-approval is not required for the Radius-operated testnet facilitator when EIP-2612 gas sponsoring is available
Amount uses 6-decimal raw units ('1000' for 0.001 SBC)
Private key is never logged or hardcoded
